about_the_game:
A DEAL DOOMED TO REPEAT

You've come to a lost laundromat in the jungle to collect a bribe, just another dirty deal in your career as a corrupt official. But as the clock ticks down the final minute, the world shatters, and you die... only to wake up again at the start of that same minute. Welcome to your personal purgatory.

60 SECONDS TO REWRITE YOUR DESTINY

Trapped in an endless time loop, knowledge is your only weapon. There is no combat, no hiding; only your wits against the clock.

Explore every corner of this oppressive environment, read documents, and connect clues to solve a series of fast-paced, interconnected puzzles. What you learn in one loop is the key to progressing in the next. Manipulate the environment, discover shortcuts, and use the strange creatures of the place, like the giant rat that is part of the cycle, to advance your escape.

A SATIRE BATHED IN FUCHSIA LIGHT

Immerse yourself in a surreal and unsettling atmosphere, rendered in a realistic style with distinctive fuchsia dusk lighting. The atmospheric sound design will make you feel like you're truly there, while the dark humor and constant satirical references to political corruption will remind you why you're trapped in the first place. This is a psychological horror experience with no jumpscares, focusing on tension and mystery.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Time Loop Escape Puzzle: Master a 60-second cycle to solve a complex escape puzzle.

  • Become the Villain: Play as a corrupt protagonist and face the surreal consequences of your actions.

  • Multiple Endings: Your decisions and discoveries within the loop will determine your fate. Will you find redemption or an eternal punishment?

  • Narrative Exploration: The story isn't told, it's discovered. Investigate the environment to unravel the mystery.

  • Surreal and Oppressive Atmosphere: A unique visual style and immersive sound design create a world that is as beautiful as it is distressing.

  • Dark Humor and Political Satire: Find biting critiques and comedic references hidden in the environmental details.

Do you have what it takes to escape the minute of your own making?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In this first-person escape puzzle, you are a corrupt official trapped in a 60-second time loop. Explore a surreal laundromat, solve frantic puzzles, and uncover the secrets of your own corruption to find the exit. Every minute is a new chance.
